entities.name: Old English (Anglo-Saxon)
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: West Germanic language brought to Britain by Angles, Saxons, and Jutes. Inflected like modern German. Beowulf is the masterwork. Changed dramatically after the Norman Conquest (1066).
